plan.objective: Grow checking deposits 10% at our Dallas branches this quarter.
steps: Resolve 'Dallas' to branch ids and pull branch performance
Find customers at those branches who do not yet hold a checking account
Compare past campaign economics by channel for this product
Pick two or three segments and a primary/secondary channel
Draft a letter, an email and two digital ads that cite the data
Run the compliance rulebook and fix every flag
Score the copy and loop back at most twice
Hold for human approval before anything ships

copy.letter:
Dear Neighbor,

A checking account built for your neighbors in Dallas. At Northwind Community Bank's Dallas branches we are offering a $200 bonus when you set up direct deposit. 

Open your Northwind Everyday Checking online in minutes or visit any of our 4 nearby branches. Offer available to new checking account customers through this quarter.

Warm regards,
The Northwind Dallas team

Member FDIC.

issues.policy_text: No piece may describe any product as "guaranteed", "guaranteed approval", "pre-approved" or "risk-free". Credit decisions depend on eligibility, so approval language must say "subject to approval" or "subject to credit approval".
issues.message: Uses 'guaranteed' or similar. Approval depends on eligibility.
issues.fix: Remove 'guaranteed'. Approval depends on eligibility; say 'subject to approval'.

issues.snippet: Guaranteed approval and FREE checking account for life.
issues.policy_text: The word "free" may only be used when the product or feature has no condition attached. If a condition exists (minimum balance, direct deposit, a time limit), the condition must appear in the same sentence as the word "free", for example "no monthly fee when you set up direct deposit".
issues.message: Says 'free' without stating the condition in the same sentence.
issues.fix: Either drop 'FREE' or state the conditions in the same sentence (e.g. 'no monthly fee with direct deposit').
